The asserted surviving type-(iii) branch is incompatible with (BAL). If phi_L has degree 3 onto a conic, then L is 2T for a base-point-free g^1_3. The CE section count gives E isomorphic to O(3)^{oplus 3}, while multiplication Sym^2 H^0(L) to H^0(L^2) has six-dimensional source and image contained in the five-dimensional pullback of H^0(P^1,O(4)). Thus h^0(F(-6)) is at least one, contradicting (BAL). Consequently the assertion that the recorded exclusions do not touch type (iii) is false.

The exact theorem statement is not established. The attempt gives only wreath-product containment and index lower bounds for type (ii), not the exact image H_alpha; it does not decide whether an entire connected balanced component can be purely type (ii); and its pointwise equality Aut(C,gamma,Gamma)=Aut(C,Gamma) does not establish the requested stack-level inertia, representability, or finite-cover assertions.

No rational-to-integral upgrade, Borel-Moore/cohomological degree conversion, Poincare-duality twist, Gysin or Kunneth shift, spectral-sequence degeneration, invariant/coinvariant identification, semisimplification upgrade, motivic prediction, pure-Tate-to-tautological upgrade, or stable-pair reduction is used to prove this geometric lemma. Those attacks therefore do not repair or supersede the failed balancedness check. The stack-versus-coarse issue remains an explicit unresolved part of the theorem.

strongest_attack: The strongest attack is the omitted CE balancedness test in CLM-0109-1. The curve-theoretic factorization 6=3*2 permits a degree-three map to a conic, but it does not place that case in the balanced Casnati-Ekedahl locus. For L=2T the induced multiplication map has a six-dimensional source whose image lies in a five-dimensional pullback space, forcing h^0(F(-6))>=1 and violating (BAL), exactly supporting packet finding FND-0153. Thus the proposed trichotomy and its claim that type (iii) survives are wrong; the type-(iii) monodromy and component-count discussion is vacuous. Independently, the attempt remains incomplete for the exact theorem because it leaves exact type-(ii) monodromy, purely type-(ii) connected components, and stack-level Aut/inertia and finite-cover behavior unresolved.
theorem_statement: Over a reduced locally Noetherian base carrying a balanced Casnati-Ekedahl genus-six degree-four family satisfying (CE), (BAL), and (N), determine the irreducible components, dimensions, deck and component stabilizers, and finite-cover behavior of the ordered evaluation-failure locus Z. In particular: compute the exact geometric monodromy image H_alpha of the finite etale S_6-ordering cover on every balanced component, including purely type-(ii) components if they exist; decide whether a connected component of the balanced base can consist entirely of type-(ii) fibres; give the resulting component count and component-stabilizer formula; and identify the relevant Aut / inertia groups for the ordered model. This lemma does not resolve the campaign Hodge/Tate group RED-0001.
